messages.text: i see all these bundles you guys have but i dont see a bundle with the t40, i have quite a few miners in my cart but i think i want the t40, would you guys be willing to do a bundle deal witha nother miner like the lucky LV08 or the Nexus S1 for a bundle deal?
Handed to the team · asked for a custom bundle/discount pairing the Magic Miner 40T with a Lucky LV08

There's no 40T bundle listed, and bundle pricing isn't mine to set — I've passed it straight to Georges and he can jump into this chat, or you'll get it by email.

Meanwhile, the 40T itself: $799, 40 TH/s, 650 W at the wall, Batch 6 ships November 21, 2026. What do you pay per kWh?
t40 with one of those miners as a bundle deal?
Searched the catalog · Nexus S1 Lucky LV08 bundle Magic Miner 40T

No 40T bundle exists, and I can't create one — Georges has your request and can jump in here or email you.

What's live today: the 40T at $799 (ships November 21, 2026), and separately the listed "Buy 1 Nexus S1, get 1 Lucky LV08 free" bundle at $699. Fair warning on that one: the S1 batch 2 is in transit and running behind.
thank you for that
Used the chat-interview skill
Before you go, one thing: what's making you lean to the 40T over the others in your cart?
how is the lucky
Searched the catalog · Lucky Miner LV08

The L.08 is the little one: 4.2 TH/s at about 120 W, near-silent, $207.20 on final sale. It's a pure lottery ticket — a tenth of the 40T's hashrate, so it stacks very little, but it's quiet, cheap and easy to set up next to a bigger rig.
well i noticed it was the best on thechart you guys have and i want that little extra chance to win

Makes sense — every extra TH is another draw at the full block, and the LV08 adds them for about 120 W.

Want me to build the cart with both: Magic Miner 40T at $799, ships November 21, 2026, plus the LV08 at $207.20, which ships from stock now?
honestly which will make me more money and chances of winning the t40 or the b30
Ran the power-cost calculator · 12¢/kWh

The 40T, on both counts. 40 TH/s against the B30's 30, and it's $799 against $899 — more draws per day and cheaper per terahash.

At home power the sats usually come to less than the electricity — that's not why people buy it. You're buying more tickets in every block, and the 40T buys more of them.

Want the cart with the 40T and the LV08?
most likely but wait so the t40 probably wil cost me a little on my bill right but its a lottery ticket your saying?

That's it. 650 W at the wall is about 468 kWh a month — roughly $56 at 12 cents a kWh, $47 at 10. It stacks small sats to your own wallet meanwhile, and it draws for a full block, 3.125 BTC, every ten minutes for years. The ticket never expires.

What do you pay per kWh?
i dont know yet but im in florida so rouchly 14-15 cents i think
Ran the power-cost calculator · 14.5¢/kWh

In Florida at 14.5 cents, the 40T runs about $68 a month in power, and the LV08 adds roughly $12.

That's the cost of keeping 44 TH/s drawing at every block, around the clock, plus the sats it stacks to your own wallet. Want me to build that cart?
how many sats a day does it stack im sorry to keep asking
Ran the power-cost calculator · 14.5¢/kWh

Never apologise for asking.

Honestly, I won't throw a number at you I can't stand behind — pool payouts at 40 TH/s move daily with difficulty and the BTC price. It's small: think pocket change against that $68, not a cheque.

Georges is already on this chat for the bundle question and can give you the live figure.
yea but shouldnt the reqards cover the electricity most likely? maybe few sats on top?

At home power the sats usually come to less than the electricity — that's not why people buy it.

You're buying the shot at a full block, 3.125 BTC, drawn every ten minutes for years, and you still own the machine after every draw. Plus you learn how mining, pools and wallets actually work, on hardware sitting in your own room.
yea ok sorry thats right, but with the combo will it bring in any sats?

Yes — pointed at a pool, both units pay out real Bitcoin to your own wallet, steadily, no exchange and no KYC. Small amounts, but they're yours and they stack.

Or run them solo and every share is a swing at the full block instead. You can switch either unit between the two whenever you like.

Shall I build the cart?
what do you mean switch im sorry i cant run both same time?

Sorry, my wording. Both miners run at the same time, always. The switch is per machine: each one is pointed either at a pool or at solo, in its settings.

So you could run the 40T on a pool for steady sats and the LV08 solo for the lottery shot. Or both the same way. Your call, changeable any time.
ohhhh i would probably put both on the lottery shot

That's how most people run them — both ship in solo mode by default, so it's the out-of-the-box setup.

Let me build it: Magic Miner 40T, $799, ships November 21, 2026, plus the Lucky LV08 at $207.20 from stock. Say go and I'll hand you the checkout link.
i might neew you help settning up once i get it can you guys do that?

Yes. Come back to this chat when it lands and we'll walk you through it — power on, get it on your wifi, point it where you want. The 40T runs Harlo OS; its firmware and docs live at harlolabs.com.

Want me to build the cart now?
yes please, do i need the power source plug?
Built a cart

Cart's built — $1,006.20 for both, US plug matched to your Florida address:

https://heliumdeploy.myshopify.com/cart/c/····

No extra power source needed. The 40T has a built-in PSU and takes a standard IEC cord, and the LV08 ships with its supply. 40T ships November 21, 2026; the LV08 goes out from stock.
no i mean the power kit

The P. Kit is optional, $69.99 — a plug-in energy monitor plus an AC cable. Nothing in your cart needs it to run.

It's handy if you want to see exactly what the 40T pulls and what it's costing you each month, rather than trusting my 14.5-cent math. Want me to add it?
doesnt it shwo the same info on the miner or no?

Close, yes. Harlo OS reports the miner's own power figure on the dashboard, so you'll see roughly what it's drawing without the kit.

The kit measures at the wall, which is the number your utility bills you on, and it covers anything else you plug into it. Honestly, for one miner the dashboard is usually enough — skip it.
ok thank you
Cart's waiting on that link whenever you're ready, and come back here when it lands and we'll get it set up. Good luck with the block.
thank you let me transfer some money then ill purchase
Sounds good. The link stays live, so come back to it when the funds land. Card, PayPal, Afterpay and Solana Pay all work at checkout.
